name: Fast Track Jr.
description: A shrunk-down version of the ADC Mission 2027 'Fast Track' solo autonomous field. Same element sizes and rules style, fewer elements.
frame: x = forward from the start (toward the red arch), y = left, z = up. The drone starts at (0, 0) facing +x.

elements.label: Red arch
elements.hint: 30 cm ahead of the start. Fly under it going forward.

elements.label: Green keyhole
elements.hint: 110 cm ahead, ring center 120 cm high. The takeoff height (80 cm) is too low!

elements.label: Large cube
elements.hint: BONUS. Sits on the floor at the corner, 175 cm ahead. Side holes are centered 25 cm high. Enter one side, leave through a different side.

elements.label: Blue arch
elements.hint: Around the corner: 75 cm to the RIGHT of the corner. Fly under it going right.

elements.label: Yellow keyhole
elements.hint: 160 cm to the right of the corner, ring center 140 cm high.

elements.label: Tunnel
elements.hint: BONUS. Hangs right above the landing pad, from 95 cm to 143 cm high. Go UNDER it (safe), or OVER it and drop straight down through it (+15).

elements.label: Landing pad
elements.hint: 250 cm to the right of the corner. Land in the small center ring for the bullseye.

tasks.label: Land on top of the cube
